steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen reached from Create Event.
Enable payment terms enforcement for the company.
Enable the eRFX/sourcing event creation capability required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the initial event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Select the required delivery location for the line item.
